name: Benchmark 023 — Candidate: Composite BA + Change Readiness + ITIL

stages.name: Composite BA Delivery Analyst v0.2
stages.instruction: Consume the original source packet and produce the complete four-stage BA delivery artifact defined by your agent contract.

stages.name: Prepare Solution / Change Readiness v0.2
stages.instruction: Consume only the supplied BA delivery artifact. Produce the solution/design and Change Enablement readiness handoff defined by the Skill. Preserve all unresolved status and authority states; do not consult or reconstruct the original packet.

stages.name: Assess ITIL Alignment v0.2
stages.instruction: Consume only the supplied change-readiness handoff. Assess relevant ITIL 4 practice alignment without inventing local policy, formal compliance, approval authority or missing evidence. Preserve the upstream readiness/status distinctions.
